asr.full_text: Hi there! My name is David and I will, in less than two minutes, let you in on a fantastic opportunity revolutionising the digital currency space of today's economy. Digital currencies are clearly the future of payments online and have been one of the hottest financial topics this year. It all started back in 2008, when a revolutionary digital currency was introduced on the internet called Bitcoin. It took only five years for this new currency to grow in value from one single sand to $1,000 . It is widely used and well known. Thousands of people have profited from this currency, and it has it more than 75 times this year. Bitcoin was one of the most successful financial investments of 2013. Clearly a new era is born in digital currencies and today you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called OneCoin OneCoin is a new currency called OneCoin. OneCoin is a new kind of cryptocurrency with strong values connected to innovation and profitability for holders of the coin. OneCoin will be introduced through our education program... ...where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency. With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens . These Tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our Exchange with thousands of other members, practise your skills, and let you profit from what you have learned through our One Academy program. The ONE tokens can be exchanged once you feel proficient enough to start trading with cryptocurrency. As a member you will get your own back office where you will learn about one coin concept, get access to your education packages and follow the progress of the business and stay updated on the latest news. Follow your tokens portfolio via the back-office and see it grow through our split program. The split program can double your tokens portfolio. Each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times. This means if you're active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks. By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE Network, and by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team. The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business, but gives you a chance to offer your contacts a way into profiting from the successful industry of cryptocurrency, and especially from the new currency, Onecoin. Take your chance and register today. We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase if you want to profit from cryptocurrency and build your future success with OneCoin, today is your chance. Fill out our simple registration form, secure your future and join the One Network. your work.

textual.observation: The source promotes OneCoin education packages that provide free trading tokens and presents those tokens as a way to trade and potentially profit.

evidence.quote: With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens .

These Tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our Exchange with thousands of other members, practise your skills, and let you profit from what you have learned through our One Academy program.

textual.context: Promotional presentation of a cryptocurrency-related education and trading opportunity. The records do not establish whether the packages, tokens, exchange or returns function as described.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised benefit of free trading tokens and potential profit is linked to obtaining education packages and participating in the promoted trading program.
textual.limitations: The source does not state the package price, establish actual token value or liquidity, or verify that users profited.

textual.observation: The source describes a split program that can double a token portfolio and increase its value within under ten weeks for active participants.

evidence.quote: The split program can double your tokens portfolio.
This means if you're active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks.

textual.context: Promotional claim with an activity condition; the records do not clarify what activity is required or whether the stated increase is guaranteed.
textual.potential_relevance: A specific portfolio-growth claim is tied to being active in the program and includes a short timeframe, creating a return-and-condition relationship for later assessment.
textual.limitations: No source record verifies the split mechanism, the meaning of active participation, the actual timeframe, or whether the claim is guaranteed.

textual.observation: The source offers bonuses for becoming an active marketing partner, building a sales team and popularizing OneCoin.

evidence.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE Network, and by popularizing ONE coin you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.

The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business, but gives you a chance to offer your contacts a way into profiting from the successful industry of cryptocurrency, and especially from the new currency, Onecoin.

textual.context: Promotional recruitment and sales-team offer. The source does not establish whether bonuses were paid or whether contacts earned profits.
textual.potential_relevance: Bonus eligibility and a claimed business opportunity are linked to recruiting or building a sales team and contacting others about OneCoin.
textual.limitations: The records do not provide the compensation structure, participation costs, eligibility details, or outcome evidence.

textual.observation: The source urges viewers to register during a first launch phase with a limited number of positions while associating registration with cryptocurrency profit and future success.

textual.context: Promotional registration call with stated scarcity and urgency. The records do not clarify what information the registration form requests.
textual.potential_relevance: Registration is directly linked to claimed cryptocurrency profit or future success and is presented with a limited-availability and immediate-action condition.
textual.limitations: The source does not establish whether positions were actually limited, what registration required, or whether registration produced the promised outcome.

visual.observation: A OneCoin-branded presentation displays education packages and states that the viewer can increase portfolio value in just under 10 weeks, with a graphic showing the value rising and text indicating it can split up to two times.
visual.context: Promotional-looking presentation by an on-screen presenter; the surrounding context is not otherwise established by the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated portfolio-value increase and split claim is presented alongside package information, creating a return-related claim connected to the promoted offering.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the claim is guaranteed, what payment or participation is required, whether the packages were purchased, or whether any outcome occurred.

visual.observation: The presentation repeatedly shows a OneCoin signup URL along the bottom while the presenter discusses or displays package, portfolio, and bonus-plan material.
visual.context: The visible presenter, OneCoin branding, package graphics, and signup URL indicate an apparent promotional presentation, but the sampled frames do not provide its full spoken or written context.
visual.potential_relevance: A signup destination is shown in connection with financial-growth and bonus-plan claims, which conditionally merits review as an action linked to a promised benefit.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show a completed signup, payment, transfer, requested personal information, specific bonus terms, or a verified destination; the sparse sampling cannot establish what was said between frames.

visual_context_notes.observation: OneCoin branding and a signup URL are visibly repeated during a presentation featuring package and portfolio graphics.
A slide visibly labels the material as an education program and shows multiple package-like product graphics.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin participation through claims that a split program can double a token portfolio in under ten weeks and urges viewers to register to secure their future. It also links bonuses to becoming a marketing partner and building a sales team, while encouraging viewers to offer contacts a way to profit, making recruitment-dependent earnings central to the solicitation. The video presents these financial and recruitment benefits as a limited opportunity rather than as neutral market commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earnings relationship depends on becoming a marketing partner, building a sales team, and qualifying for bonuses. S05 is also evidenced because OneCoin tokens and the split program are linked to increasing portfolio value and profiting from the cryptocurrency.
